task: Offline forensic/design analysis of the technical difference between full-Chromium headed and full-Chromium headless that could explain Naukri's HTTP 403 to the latter
evidence_completeness_caveat: Full untruncated command-line evidence exists only for one unrelated run (default chromium_headless_shell binary, headless). The two runs actually being compared here (channel='chromium' headed vs headless) both have process-evidence truncated at 300 characters, cutting off at the identical point before reaching headless-specific flags. Claims about the exact channel='chromium' pairing are therefore INFERENCE by analogy, not direct FACT, where noted.

1_chromium_executable.headed_path: chromium-1243/chrome-mac-arm64/Google Chrome for Testing.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome for Testing
1_chromium_executable.label: FACT

2_launch_arguments.inference_basis: Playwright's headless-conditional argument construction is not channel-dependent; the same logic branch applies regardless of which binary channel is ultimately resolved

2_launch_arguments.not_determinable: whether --enable-unsafe-swiftshader and the touch-emulation blink-settings flag are present or absent in the headed channel='chromium' run specifically -- truncated before that point

user_agent.label: FACT - no override in code, either mode

headless_requirement_reframing.actual_operational_requirement: no user-visible browser UI / background execution

legitimate_background_execution_options.risk: Not available on macOS (X11/Linux concept); would require migrating browser execution to a Linux host/container. This project already has docker-compose.yml for other services, making this architecturally plausible but a real infrastructure change.

legitimate_background_execution_options.risk: No first-class macOS equivalent to Xvfb; not a clean architectural guarantee of invisibility

legitimate_background_execution_options.option: Tune headless-mode rendering flags to avoid SwiftShader software fallback
legitimate_background_execution_options.uses_genuine_headed_rendering: partially - real GPU path instead of software fallback, if available
